related_posts.label: Related Post
related_posts.description: Display related posts for single post. This will only work for single post.

posts_number.label: Post Count
posts_number.description: Choose how much posts you would like to display per page.

use_current_loop.label: Posts For Current Page
use_current_loop.description: Display posts for the current page. Useful on archive and index pages.

offset_number.label: Post Offset Number
offset_number.description: Choose how many posts you would like to skip. These posts will not be shown in the feed.

icon_color.label: Icon Color
icon_color.description: Here you can define a custom color for your icon.
